title: Je finis, j'attends
intro: You know the **-er** verbs (*parler*). Now the two other big families: verbs in **-ir** (*finir, partir, ouvrir*) and in **-re** (*attendre, prendre*). Good news: in each group, *je, tu* and *il* sound the same, so most of the work is the spelling and the plural.

cases.label: finir: je finis, il finit
cases.rule: Most -ir verbs work like **finir**: remove *-ir* and add **-is, -is, -it**: *je finis, tu finis, il finit*. All three sound the same: /fi.ni/.

cases.label: nous finissons: + iss
cases.rule: In the plural, these verbs add **-iss-**: *nous finissons, vous finissez, ils finissent*. The same goes for *choisir, réussir, grandir, réfléchir*.

cases.label: partir, sortir, dormir
cases.rule: A small group loses a consonant in the singular: *je pars, je sors, je dors* (also *servir, sentir*). It comes back in the plural: *nous partons, ils dorment*. No *-iss-*!

cases.label: ouvrir: -er endings
cases.rule: **ouvrir, offrir, découvrir, cueillir** take the endings of -er verbs: *j'ouvre, tu ouvres, il ouvre, nous ouvrons, ils ouvrent*.

cases.label: attendre: il attend
cases.rule: -re verbs: remove *-re* and add **-s, -s, (nothing), -ons, -ez, -ent**: *j'attends, tu attends, **il attend***, *nous attendons, vous attendez, ils attendent*. The same for *entendre, répondre, vendre, perdre, descendre*.

cases.label: prendre: nous prenons, ils prennent
cases.rule: **prendre**, **apprendre** and **comprendre** lose the **d** in the plural: *nous prenons, vous prenez*, and take **nn** with *ils*: *ils prennent*.

cases.label: hearing the plural
cases.rule: *il finit / ils finissent*, *il attend / ils attendent*, *il dort / ils dorment*: in the plural you **hear a consonant**: /fi.nis/, /a.tɑ̃d/, /dɔʁm/.

cases.label: giving orders
cases.rule: The imperative uses the **tu, nous, vous** forms without the pronoun: *Finis ! Attends ! Choisissez ! Partons !* Verbs with -er endings drop the **s**: *Ouvre la porte !*

sections.title: 1. -ir verbs like finir: the singular
text: Take **finir** (to finish): remove **-ir**, then add **-is, -is, -it**. The three forms sound exactly the same: /fi.ni/.

examples.fr: {Je finis|irr-finir} mon travail à six heures.
examples.en: I finish my work at six.

sections.title: 2. The plural: -iss-
text: In the plural, verbs like *finir* add **-iss-** before the ending.
sections.tip: Other verbs like *finir*: **choisir** (to choose), **réussir** (to succeed, to pass), **grandir** (to grow up), **réfléchir** (to think).

sections.title: 3. partir, dormir, sortir: a different group
text: These common verbs **don't** take *-iss-*. In the singular they lose the consonant before *-ir* (*part-ir → je pars*). It comes back in the plural.

examples.en: Are you sleeping in the tent?

sections.tip: The same pattern: **servir** (je sers, nous servons) and **sentir** (je sens, nous sentons).

sections.title: 4. ouvrir and friends: -er endings
text: A few -ir verbs behave like -er verbs: **-e, -es, -e, -ons, -ez, -ent**.

examples.fr: {Il offre|irr-ouvrir} des fleurs à sa mère.

sections.title: 5. -re verbs like attendre
text: Remove **-re** and add **-s, -s, -ons, -ez, -ent**. With *il / elle* there's **no ending at all**: *il attend*.
sections.tip: The same pattern: **entendre** (to hear), **vendre** (to sell), **perdre** (to lose), **descendre** (to go down). And **attendre** already means *to wait for*: *j'attends le bus* (no *pour*!).

sections.title: 6. prendre, apprendre, comprendre
text: **prendre** is irregular in the plural: the **d** disappears, and *ils* takes **nn**.
sections.tip: Listen to the vowel: *nous prenons* /pʁə.nɔ̃/ but *ils prennent* /pʁɛn/.

sections.title: 7. Hearing the plural
text: In the singular, the last consonant is silent. In the plural (*ils, elles*), you **hear** a consonant. That's how you know there's more than one person.
sections.tip: Compare the -er verbs: *il parle* and *ils parlent* sound **exactly the same**. With -ir and -re verbs, your ear can tell the difference.

sections.title: 8. Giving orders
text: The imperative uses the **tu, nous, vous** forms without the subject. Verbs with -er endings (*ouvrir, cueillir*) drop the **s** of *tu*, like *parle !*

mistakes.why: Verbs like *finir* add **-iss-** in the plural.

story.title: La nuit au refuge
story.en: After a long hike, the friends spend the night in a mountain hut.

lines.fr: Après la randonnée, les amis arrivent au refuge, à deux mille mètres.
lines.en: After the hike, the friends reach the mountain hut, at two thousand metres.

lines.fr: Bonsoir ! {Vous choisissez|irr-iss} vos lits ? Le dîner {finit|irr-finir} à neuf heures.
lines.en: Good evening! Will you choose your beds? Dinner finishes at nine.

lines.fr: {Je choisis|irr-finir} ce lit, près de la fenêtre !
lines.en: I'm choosing this bed, near the window!

lines.fr: La gardienne {sert|irr-partir} une soupe chaude. Tout le monde a faim.
lines.en: The warden serves a hot soup. Everyone is hungry.
Mmm… Can you smell that? It smells good!

lines.fr: Après le dîner, Léa {ouvre|irr-ouvrir} la porte. Dehors, il fait nuit et il fait froid.
lines.en: After dinner, Léa opens the door. Outside, it's dark and cold.

lines.fr: Venez voir ! On {découvre|irr-ouvrir} des milliers d'étoiles !
lines.en: Come and see! You can see thousands of stars!

lines.fr: {Ils sortent|irr-hear}. Dans le silence, {ils entendent|irr-hear} le vent.
lines.en: They go outside. In the silence, they hear the wind.
I can hear a noise… Is it a wolf?

lines.fr: Mais non, Hugo ! C'est une vache. Ici, les vaches {dorment|irr-hear} dehors !
lines.en: Of course not, Hugo! It's a cow. Here, the cows sleep outside!

lines.fr: À dix heures, tout le monde {dort|irr-partir}… sauf Hugo.
lines.en: At ten o'clock, everyone is asleep… except Hugo.

lines.fr: {Je ne dors pas|irr-partir} : {j'attends|irr-attendre} le lever du soleil !
lines.en: I'm not sleeping: I'm waiting for the sunrise!

lines.fr: À six heures, le ciel devient rose. Hugo appelle ses amis.
lines.en: At six o'clock, the sky turns pink. Hugo calls his friends.

lines.fr: {Ils prennent|irr-prendre} des photos. Le soleil se lève derrière les montagnes.
lines.en: They take photos. The sun is rising behind the mountains.

lines.fr: Merci, Hugo ! Pour une fois, {tu réussis|irr-finir} quelque chose !
lines.en: Thank you, Hugo! For once, you've pulled something off!

lines.fr: {Vous comprenez|irr-prendre} maintenant ? Je ne suis pas toujours en retard !
lines.en: Do you see now? I'm not always late!

quiz.q: Je ___ mon travail à six heures.
quiz.en: I finish my work at six.
Are you sleeping in the tent?

quiz.q: Lou ___ des fleurs pour sa mère.
quiz.en: Lou picks flowers for her mother.

quiz.q: Which pair sounds exactly the same?
How do you tell a friend “Wait!”?
